intent: Block the repeated notice wording stays in the tooling register. Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.
source:
**Frame:** One sentence from the notices is lifted out and set large, in their own register.
Behind it, small and unemphasized, the two dates.

**Screen / system text — STORED NOTICE (PARAPHRASED):**
`THE SAFEGUARDS ARE INTENTIONALLY BROAD. BREADTH LETS US DELIVER CAPABILITY FASTER.`

**Caption:**
> THIS BOOK CALLS THAT A RACE AND MARKS IT AS ITS OWN ANALYSIS.
>
> HERE IT IS A PRODUCT NOTICE.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — `CI-REFUSAL`, both events, paraphrased. The
vendor states the trade in its own words, twice, more than seven weeks apart. That this is the same
trade [page 097](097.md) bounds as project analysis is the project's observation.
title: The repeated notice wording stays in the tooling register
